import re

    m=re.match(r'(\S+?):(\d+): "(.*)"\s*$',l.rstrip('\n'))
    if not m: continue
    p,n,ex=m.groups(); n=int(n)
    ls=ex.replace('\\n','\n').replace('\\"','"').split('\n')
    for i,s in enumerate(ls):
        if 'decode_pin(' in s:
            a=s.split('decode_pin(',1)[1]
            if a.startswith('&changed(') or (a.strip()=='' and i+1<len(ls) and ls[i+1].strip().startswith('&changed(')):
                res.add((p,n+i))
out=[]
